name: Sarah Vaughan
description: '''Sarah Lois Vaughan''' ({{IPAc-en|v|ɔː|n|}} {{Respell|VAWN}}; March 27, 1924 – April 3, 1990) was an American [[jazz]] singer and pianist. Nicknamed "Sassy", "[[List of nicknames of jazz musicians|The Divine One]]", and the "Queen of Bebop", music critic [[Scott Yanow]] wrote that she had "one of the most wondrous voices of the 20th century". Her accolades include the 1989 [[NEA Jazz Masters]] honor, and a [[Grammy Awards|Grammy Award]] from a total of nine nominations. Vaughan is also the recipient of the [[Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award]].
